name: Azure AI Translator
tagline: Cloud translation for text and documents across 100+ languages
description: Microsoft Azure AI Translator provides neural machine translation for text, documents, and custom models. It supports 100+ languages with features like language detection, transliteration, dictionary lookup, and custom translation via Custom Translator. Developers call regional or global endpoints with subscription keys or Microsoft Entra ID.

auth.details: Subscription key via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header (or Authorization Bearer for Entra ID); region via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region for multi-service resources

pricing.paid_plans: Standard S1 pay-as-you-go by character volume; commitment tiers and custom models available

example.request: curl -X POST "https://api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com/translate?api-version=3.0&to=es" -H "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region: YOUR_REGION" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '[{"Text":"Hello, world!"}]'

use_cases: batch-translate localization strings for an app
look up dictionary translations for a word
